Introduction

Xinyu is a Chinese singer and dancer under MODHAUS.

On July 7, 2021, Xinyu was announced as a contestant on Mnet's survival show "Girls Planet 999". She was supposed to be eliminated during the second round of eliminations but was saved by the planet masters. Xinyu was eliminated from the show during the eleventh episode. She was also a contestant on Youku's survival show "Great Dance Crew" in 2022.

Xinyu was introduced as the fifteenth member of the girl group tripleS under MODHAUS on July 2, 2023. She first debuted with the sub-unit LOVElution on August 17, 2023, with the mini album "ↀ (MUHAN)". Xinyu then made her debut with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".

As a member of tripleS, Xinyu was placed in the sub-units LOVElution, Visionary Vision, and Sun.
